summary: Digital Currency X Technology Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing unaudited pro forma condensed financial information for the disposal of its wholly-owned subsidiary, Chijet Inc., via a share purchase agreement previously reported. Terms such as price, premium, and dates are not disclosed in this excerpt. The board's recommendation and advisors are not mentioned. The pro forma statements include elimination of Chijet Inc.'s assets and liabilities, showing the estimated impact of the divestiture. The filing indicates a non-US registrant (Hong Kong-based) filing under US Rule 13a-16. Watch for closing conditions and regulatory clearance in China/Hong Kong.
